title: Quasi-coherence from graded-module chart identifications
statement: Let $S$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring with grading $\mathcal A$, and $M$ a $\mathbb Z$-graded $S$-module with internal grading $\mathcal M$ compatible with scalar multiplication. Set $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Index charts by pairs $f=(a,d)$ with $d>0$ and $a\in S_d$, put $D_f=D_+(a)$, $R_f=S_{(a)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], and let $Z_f$ be submodules of $M_a$ whose carriers are precisely the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions]. Suppose additive maps $\rho_{f,g}:Z_f\to Z_g$ and ring maps $\rho^S_{f,g}:R_f\to R_g$ are given for every $D_g\subseteq D_f$. Suppose each inclusion admits a homogeneous relation $g^e=bf$ with $e>0$, each $\rho$ is semilinear over $\rho^S$, and for every such relation it sends $y/f^m$ to $b^my/g^{em}$. Assume identities, composition and bijectivity when chart opens coincide. Assume moreover every ring restriction is induced by a ring map $S_f\to S_g$ commuting with $S$. Let $F$ be any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with additive identifications $F(D_f)\cong Z_f$, scalar compatible via awayToSection and restriction compatible with $\rho$. Then $F$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. This statement asserts no construction or uniqueness of an extension.

proof.text: Apply gradedModuleChart_tildeComparison to obtain, on each positive homogeneous chart f, an isomorphism between the restriction of F and the tilde sheaf of Z_f transported along basicOpenIsoSpec. This is exactly the affine comparison from steps 1--3 of the original proof.

Mathlib tilde is quasi-coherent and restriction along the chart isomorphism preserves quasi-coherence. Transport through the comparison isomorphism. The private, fully proved chartOverQuasicoherent transports the result from the open subscheme to F.over D_f via overEquiv and its inverse; these preserve the structure module and local presentations.

Reindex Mathlib affineOpenCover: an index j consisting of a positive degree and a homogeneous element gives f=(j.2.1,j.1). Its opensRange is D_f by opensRange_awayι. Therefore every point belongs to one of the D_f, so their supremum is top. This also handles empty Proj.
Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop to the cover f↦D_f and the quasi-coherent restrictions F.over D_f.

proof_origin.note: Compiling reduction: the single-chart comparison is isolated; transfer of quasi-coherence and the standard-open cover locality are proved in Lean.

mathlib_searches.results: Structure-sheaf and chart isomorphisms only; basis topology lemmas only. No matching module gluing or indexed extension declaration.

Existing exists_sheafOfModules_from_basis takes a set of opens, not an indexed basis. Existing gradedModuleAwayRestriction supplies localization comparisons, not finite chart gluing or quasi-coherence of a given sheaf.
